summary_en: ONE CAREER authorized acquisition of up to 552,000 shares (3.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 1,000 million yen through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13, 2026 to May 12, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
ONE CAREER Inc. (Ticker: 4377, TSE Growth Market) announced on November 12, 2026 that its Board of Directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 552,000 shares of the company's common stock. The acquisition limit represents 3.0% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The maximum purchase price is set at 1,000 million yen, with no individual price ceiling disclosed. Acquisitions will be conducted through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement, spanning from November 13, 2026 through May 12, 2027.

The company cited flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business environments, improved capital efficiency, and enhanced shareholder returns as the objectives for this buyback program. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 7,655 shares of treasury stock against 18,428,285 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
